data.context: Paul Moon In an indictment unsealed by the U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) on Aug. 1, 2018, three Ukrainian nationals have been charged with conspiracy, wire fraud, computer hacking, access device fraud and aggravated identity theft.

evidence.quote: three Ukrainian nationals have been charged

data.context: The arrests took place between January and June 2018, and coincided with a slowdown in CARBON SPIDER activity.

evidence.quote: a slowdown in CARBON SPIDER activity

data.context: The DoJ announcement also details the group's use of a front company, named Combi Security, to recruit developers and intrusion specialists for its operations.

evidence.quote: The DoJ announcement also details the group's use of a front company, named Combi Security,

data.context: This includes the group dubbed RATPAK SPIDER (also known as Buhtrap) that targets Russian and Ukrainian financial institutions, a group dubbed Odinaff targeting SWIFT systems particularly in Eastern Europe, and the group COBALT SPIDER (also known as Cobalt) that, again, specializes in targeting Russian banks.

evidence.quote: that targets Russian and Ukrainian financial institutions

data.context: One of the payloads was an instance of Agent ORM used to targeted casinos; a second payload also used by CARBON SPIDER was an instance of Sekur.

evidence.quote: targeted casinos

data.context: Odinaff A SWIFT compromise was observed in mid-2016, targeting a Ukrainian bank that at the time was unattributed.

evidence.quote: targeting a Ukrainian bank

data.context: Later, this group was reported in open source as Odinaff.

evidence.quote: Later, this group was reported in open source as Odinaff.

data.context: In addition to similar TTPs, there appeared to be some infrastructure overlap with two IP addresses.

evidence.quote: there appeared to be some infrastructure overlap

evidence.quote: as a Sekur plugin server

data.context: The Cobalt group, tracked by CrowdStrike intelligence as COBALT SPIDER, bears many similarities in the targeting of banks to the Russian cluster of CARBON SPIDER activity.

evidence.quote: targeting of banks
